correctness.rationale: The theorem holds. The restriction of the inverse Fourier transform from the band to a finite observation set is Hilbert–Schmidt, and its product with its adjoint is the sinc compression. Strict positivity on the single interval ensures a simple even positive top state. Reflection on the translated interval followed by the two-component sum/difference gives the exact blocks T±C_D, with kernel K_W(D−x−y). Their isolated leading eigenvalues are the top two overall for large D because C_D=O(D⁻¹) in norm. At D=d+τ/d, put s=x+y and ε=(−1)^n. Expanding gives ε[−sin(ωs)/d+(ωτ cos(ωs)−s sin(ωs))/d²]/π with uniform operator O(d⁻³). The first-order kernel sends φ to −Aq/π and has expectation zero; the second-order expectation is (ωA²τ−2AB)/π. The reduced-resolvent term L is the same in both branches. Differentiating the kernel gives a uniform expansion of its τ derivative; taking its expectation in the normalized branch eigenvectors φ+O(d⁻¹) gives slope 2εωA²/(πd²)+O(d⁻³) for the signed gap. Opposite endpoint signs and strict monotonicity yield an exact unique crossing in the stated window, with detuning τ_*+O(d⁻¹). Leading-order unrestricted expansion gives the global sorted formula by parity. The area estimate uses bounded continuous K_W on finite sets, not global L¹: the word 'integrable' in the frozen assumptions is inaccurate if read globally, since |sin(ωt)|/|t| has divergent integral, but this is not a premise of the theorem or its proof. A new 64-node full-block and parity-matrix diagnostic at (a,W)=(1/4,1/2) and (0.6,0.3), including odd and even n=31,64,129, matched the branches, slope signs and centroid values; replay: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python3 /workspace/checks/frozen_review_checks.py sinc. This is numerical corroboration only.

value.rationale: An exact displaced degeneracy is scientifically more meaningful than a small numerical gap. Here, however, that degeneracy, its shift, and the doublet expansions are all reproducible from the overlapping findings; evaluating the common height then requires only substitution. The reviewed record determines no higher-order coefficient, additional band range or other separate invariant. There is no substantive remaining increment to repair.
